title: Professional Certificate in Understanding The Global Business Landscape
description: This course enables the learner to explore and analyse the global landscape a business is operating in.
longDescription: Defining Globalisation. Types of Globalisation. Understanding International Investing and its types. What is Investment Process? Globalisation and International Investment Processes: Relation. Globalisation and International Investment Processes: Key Aspects. Defining Global Business Environment. Global Business Environmental Factors. Barriers to Entry and Exit in Global Business Environment. Impacts of Globalisation on National and Multinational Business Organisations. This course enables the learner to explore and analyse the global landscape a business is operating in.
